tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce Specialist | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring & API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of experience delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, RESTful and OCC APIs, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record of designing data pipelines, leading API migrations, and translating business requirements into functional specifications. Strong stakeholder management, agile delivery, and AI-assisted development across remote, hybrid and on-site teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Produktmanager Menswear E-Commerce (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Ernsting's family commitment to delivering high-quality menswear through a cutting-edge digital experience. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep e-commerce expertise and a proven track record of driving revenue-focused online solutions.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and OCC REST services, ensuring seamless product data flow across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Product Catalog Management
bullets.text: I led the implementation of catalog and pricing models on SAP Commerce Cloud, optimizing product visibility and merchandising for B2B and B2C audiences.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Collaboration
bullets.text: Worked directly with international business owners to translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria, delivering solutions that met market needs.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, coordinated sprint planning and PI sessions, and mentored junior developers to maintain high-quality releases.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Ernsting's family stands out as a leading menswear brand that blends tradition with digital innovation. Your focus on expanding the online shopping experience aligns perfectly with my background in SAP Commerce Cloud and end-to-end e-commerce integrations. I am eager to apply my technical and techno-functional expertise to help shape a seamless, data-driven shopping journey for your customers and drive growth across all channels.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to combine my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise with Ernsting's family strong menswear brand to create a best-in-class digital shopping experience that drives growth and customer loyalty.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m keen to bring my API integration and product catalog experience to Ernsting's family’s menswear platform. Open to discuss further!
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Produktmanager Menswear E-Commerce role. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to Ernsting's family digital growth. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.

Best regards
